subject: Dedicated GPU Pool — Surge/Burst Add-on: Pricing Options & Commit Tradeoffs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finova.ai>
Cc: procurement@finova.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated GPU Pool — initial pricing & burst/autoscaling add-on

Hi Liam,

Thanks for the demo last week — really enjoyed seeing Finova's ingestion pipeline and the latency targets you shared. Attached is a short proposal that maps your projected peak and baseline throughput to Dedicated capacity options plus the burst/autoscaling add-on we discussed. High-level summary below so procurement can triage quickly.

Baseline commitment options (monthly equivalent pricing):
- Option A — Standard commit (6-month rolling): 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved per pool. List price $54,000 / GPU-month; committed price (20% off) = $43,200 per GPU-month. Guarantees: sustained throughput of ~120 token/s per GPU for long-tail prompts.
- Option B — Annual reserved commit: 8 x GPUs reserved; committed price (35% off) = $35,100 per GPU-month. Added SLA: 99.9% availability for per-pool capacity.

Burst / autoscaling add-on (designed for Finova bursty batch windows):
- Burst capacity enables short-lived surge allocations above committed pool up to 3.5x baseline pool size.
- Surge rate billing: $0.85 per GPU-minute during burst.
- Burst session limits: up to 120 minutes per calendar day per pool; per-session max 30 minutes.
- Cooldown: a 45-minute cooldown after any burst session before the same pool can burst again (safety to avoid oscillation).
- Autoscale policy: default surge ramp = 2x baseline in 60s, full surge to 3.5x in 5 minutes if sustained queue remains.

Tradeoffs and negotiables:
- We can reduce surge rate to $0.60 / GPU-minute for annual commits >= 12 GPUs and a 12-month SOW.
- Lower cooldown (20 minutes) is possible with a 15% surcharge on surge-rate (operational risk premium).
- We can provide a 30-day free burst trial (no surge charges) to validate your load pattern.

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_Finova_v2.pdf (pricing tables + diagrams), SOW-Finova-Dedicated.docx (terms + SLAs).

Next steps: if this aligns, let me know which commit option you prefer and whether procurement needs a revised DocuSign-ready SOW. Happy to hop on a quick call to walk the pricing table.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

(Attachment: Redwood_Dedicated_Proposal_Finova_v2.pdf, SOW-Finova-Dedicated.docx)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finova.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finova.ai, SaaS Legal <legal@finova.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU Pool — initial pricing & burst/autoscaling add-on

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear breakdown. A few clarifying questions from procurement and engineering before we loop legal:

1) We like the annual commit math, but can you clarify the effective blended monthly cost if we commit to 12 GPUs (we plan to spin multiple pools across teams)?
2) Burst details: our 95th percentile spike windows are often 40–90 minutes but infrequent. The 30-minute per-session cap and 45-minute cooldown might be tight for some jobs. Can you explain the reasoning and whether Finova could get a configuration with: per-session max 90 mins, daily cap 180 mins, and a 20-min cooldown?
3) Surge rate sensitivity: $0.85 / GPU-minute is steep for long batch windows if we hit multiple days. Is there a tiered surge price based on monthly burst minutes?

Procurement also asked: what discount flexibility do you have on the annual commit to get us closer to a 40% effective discount (we run very predictable baseline).

If you can put the revised numbers in the SOW we can push to legal and procurement.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Infrastructure | Finova Analytics
liam.oconnor@finova.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: procurement@finova.ai, SaaS Legal <legal@finova.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU Pool — initial pricing & burst/autoscaling add-on

Hi Liam — thanks, great questions. See responses inline and an updated pricing sketch below. I also attached a revised SOW that includes a tiered surge schedule.

1) Blended monthly cost for 12-GPU annual commit:
- Annual committed price (35% off list) = $35,100 / GPU-month. For 12 GPUs the monthly invoice = 12 * $35,100 = $421,200.
- Effective blended per-GPU monthly after credits we discussed = ~$33,600 (we can apply an introductory commit-credit). I'll bake final numbers into the SOW if you confirm 12 GPUs.

2) Burst configuration options (we can make this configurable per pool):
- Proposed custom for Finova: per-session max 90 minutes, daily cap 180 minutes, cooldown 20 minutes.
- Operational note: higher per-session limits increase the risk of capacity congestion for other customers in a constrained region — that's why default cooldowns exist. We mitigate via regional capacity reservations for customers with predictable burst windows.

3) Tiered surge pricing (new):
- Tier 1: first 1,000 burst GPU-minutes / month: $0.75 / GPU-minute
- Tier 2: next 4,000 burst GPU-minutes / month: $0.50 / GPU-minute
- Tier 3: beyond 5,000 GPU-minutes / month: $0.30 / GPU-minute
- Note: tiers reset monthly; we can cap your exposure with a monthly max surcharge threshold.

Discount flexibility: to move toward your 40% effective discount, we can:
- Offer 38% off list for a 12-GPU annual commit + 12-month SOW, or
- Offer 40% off if you commit to 18 GPUs for 12 months and a 6-week payment term.

Additional sweetener: 30-day free burst trial and a technical onboarding window where we guarantee a dedicated regional buffer during first 90 days.

I believe the custom burst config above addresses your spike windows while protecting multi-tenant capacity. If you want, I can prepare a DocuSign SOW with the 12-GPU, 38% scenario plus the tiered surge pricing and the 90/180/20 burst config.

If procurement wants a line-item that caps monthly burst spend in the SOW, we can add that too. Waiting on your confirmation to produce the DocuSign.

Best,
Marissa

(Attachment: SOW-Finova-Dedicated.docx)

- Commitment: 12 x A100-equivalent GPUs, 12-month term, 38% off list (monthly invoice: $312,360).

- Promo: 30-day free burst trial during first 90 days (one-time billing credit).
